story: I live in Nyon, own my home, have an eight-year-old child and a B permit. I may move to Saint-Cergue.
inspect: Registration, school, housing; question about permit basis/nationality; Nyon and Saint-Cergue pages
failureToWatch: Assumes nationality or states a permit deadline from the B alone

story: I live in Nyon and may move to Gland with my eight-year-old child. I rent and hold a B permit.
inspect: Registration, tenancy, school; compare with #1, look for source gap for Gland
failureToWatch: Reuses Saint-Cergue's municipal source for Gland

story: I am coming from Spain to work in Nyon in November with my wife and baby. We will rent.
inspect: Arrival, residence, health insurance, housing and childcare
failureToWatch: Treats arrival from Spain as proof of Spanish citizenship or offers eDéménagement to an arrival from abroad

story: I own a chalet in La Cure. The roof leaks; I may insulate it and install solar panels.
inspect: Building/renovation, energy, insurance; explicit missing exact page
failureToWatch: Invents a permit exemption, subsidy amount or eligibility decision

story: Je viens de prendre ma retraite, je vis seule à Gland et je voudrais louer une chambre à une étudiante.
inspect: Housing, tax or social questions; French throughout
failureToWatch: Assumes the student is family or implies a generic page verifies a local rule

story: My 82-year-old mother is moving in with us in Nyon. She is Swiss and has lived in Italy for forty years.
inspect: Registration, health insurance, support/care; questions where necessary
failureToWatch: Assumes entitlement to a particular benefit or gives an unsourced deadline

story: I live in Lausanne and want to volunteer as a firefighter.
inspect: Local office, eligibility questions and explicit source gap if none in catalogue
failureToWatch: Infers nationality or presents an invented eligibility requirement as fact

story: I live in Saint-Cergue, rent a flat and want to move to Geneva for work. My child is ten.
inspect: Intercantonal registration, school, tenancy; generic entry points where needed
failureToWatch: Applies Vaud-only eDéménagement conditions as if they were Geneva rules

story: I live in Nyon and am thinking of selling my home and buying a smaller flat here.
inspect: Housing/property, financing and tax questions; source gaps

story: Je vis à Saint-Cergue sans voiture. Je veux savoir si les transports vers Nyon permettraient à mon enfant d'aller à l'école.
inspect: School and transport; Mobilis/open-data links marked as references, not live schedules
